settings.headline: Banking that belongs to the valley
settings.subtitle: Kestrel Valley Credit Union is owned by the 48,600 people who bank here. Fair rates, plain fees, and decisions made by neighbors in Harlow, not a head office far away.

settings.headline: When we do well, members get it back
settings.body:
A credit union has no outside shareholders. After paying the bills and keeping a safe cushion, earnings go back to members as better rates, fewer fees and a year-end bonus dividend.

This year the board approved a $1.2 million bonus dividend, paid in December.
